purpose: Teach: 希薄/発端/制覇/切実/偏差/弁論/捕獲/子宮

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地方の人口希薄化を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were working on rural depopulation in your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, curious. Leans forward slightly. Genuine interest — she's checking in on his work, not testing him. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、紛争の発端を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the origins of conflict.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest. Slight hesitation — he's correcting her gently, not defensively. Eyes briefly down, then back up. Careful with his words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、リーグ制覇の戦略を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were looking at league championship strategy in your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Gentle pause before his name. Thoughtful tone — she's reflecting, perhaps realizing a mismatch. Not accusatory. Inviting him to clarify.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、難民の切実な状況を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the urgent circumstances facing refugees.
lines.style: Patient, steady. He's accepting the correction without frustration. Soft emphasis on 'urgent.' His tone suggests he's used to this kind of dialogue.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 教育の地域偏差を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: You were covering regional disparities in education, weren't you?
lines.style: Alert, engaged. Quick beat of recognition — she's following a thread now. Her tone brightens slightly, more present. Conversational rhythm picks up.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、伝統的な弁論術を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on classical rhetoric and argumentation.
lines.style: Clear, focused. He's tracking her well now. No hesitation. Slight warmth in his voice — there's a rhythm forming between them. Direct but not curt.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、絶滅危惧種の捕獲規制を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were writing about regulations on endangered species capture, weren't you?
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. Reflective — she's seeing the pattern now, or checking herself. Slight wonder in her voice. Not testing, observing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、子宮頸がんの予防医療を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered preventive medicine for cervical cancer.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. Small smile in his voice — maybe relief that they've landed on something that matters. Warm close. Breath settles at the end.
